scripts.deploy:development: sudo echo && npm run minikube:start && parallelshell 'npm run minikube:loadApi' 'npm run loadAndStart'
scripts.deploy:development:hard: sudo echo && npm run deploy:development:clear && npm run deploy:development && npm run init:lightning
scripts.build:homepage: docker build -t gcr.io/$(gcloud config get project)/homepage -f infrastructure/spec/homepage.Dockerfile ./homepage && docker push gcr.io/$(gcloud config get project)/homepage
scripts.watch:api: echo $(ksync init) && (ksync watch &) && sleep 5 && ksync delete --all && ksync create --selector=app=development-api $(pwd)/api/src /usr/src/app/api/src && kubectl logs --follow --selector=app=development-api
scripts.watch:wait: bash -c 'while ksync get | grep watching > /dev/null; do sleep 1 echo "working..." done'
scripts.minikube:dns: sudo echo && npm run minikube:tunnel && npm run minikube:dashboard && parallelshell 'minikube addons enable gcp-auth' 'minikube addons enable ingress' 'minikube addons enable ingress-dns' 'npx ts-node infrastructure/minikube/minikube-dns.ts'
scripts.minikube:deploy: echo $(kubectl delete -A ValidatingWebhookConfiguration ingress-nginx-admission) && python3 infrastructure/minikube/minikube.py && minikube kubectl -- apply -f infrastructure/minikube/minikube.yaml --validate=false
scripts.minikube:loadHomepage: eval $(minikube docker-env) && (docker image inspect gcr.io/$(gcloud config get project)/homepage:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo no || npm run build:homepage)
scripts.minikube:loadApi: eval $(minikube docker-env) && (docker image inspect api:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo no || docker build --target development -t api:latest -f api/Dockerfile .)
scripts.minikube:removeHomepage: minikube image rm gcr.io/$(gcloud config get project)/homepage || true
scripts.clearcloudcache: gsutil rm -ra gs://sudonym-development-bitcoin-backup/** || true && gsutil rm -ra gs://sudonym-development-lightning-backup/** || true && gsutil rm -ra gs://sudonym-development-lightning-backup-2/** || true && gsutil rm -ra gs://sudonym-development-lightning-backup-3/** || true
scripts.loadAndStart: npm run minikube:dns && npm run minikube:deploy
